name: The 267-Seed Square-Code and Single-Sign-Break Census
definition: Use the coordinate-zero contraction and overlap of the labelled 267-concept obstruction; their complement has connected-component orders 90 and 59. For the square block, enumerate every ordered pair of omitted words. Separately, start with its 683-concept binary block replacement and flip the block-coordinate sign in exactly one of its 93 mixed signed clauses.
parameters: The square-code domain has 16 ordered pairs. The bounded sign-break domain has 93 one-clause modifications of a fixed 13-coordinate presentation.
properties: Among the square codes, the four equal pairs are dismantlable ample, the eight distinct nonantipodal pairs have a negative proper face, and the four antipodal pairs are forbidden block replacements. Among the 93 single-sign changes, exactly four outputs are ample, with respective orders 649, 639, 645, and 634 and corner counts 2, 2, 1, and 2; all thirteen signed columns remain distinct in these four outputs.
